description: REPLACE the live site's files and database with the staging site's. A fresh on-demand backup of live is taken first (replacing any existing on-demand backup), so it can be undone with restore_wordpress_backup. Takes several minutes; poll get_wordpress_staging. Always confirm with the user first.
